accepted.sentence: An enclosed base supports a heavy aquarium while concealing its filtration equipment and water-treatment supplies.
A fitted kitchen enclosure holds a built-in oven at a convenient height while keeping its controls accessible.
An enclosure beneath a laundry worktop can house a front-loading washer while preserving access for repairs.
In a church sacristy, enclosed storage protects ceremonial vessels and vestments between services.
School science preparation rooms use fitted storage to keep glassware close at hand and leave benches clear for experiments.
Music rehearsal rooms use tall enclosed storage to keep instrument cases upright and separated, reducing accidental knocks between sessions.
A fitted enclosure beside a fireplace keeps logs and kindling nearby while containing loose bark and wood debris.
In a brewery taproom, enclosed storage keeps clean glassware near serving taps and shielded from dust between uses.
